design.notes:
Review copy / position60 / source ID060. Geometry unchanged; Specific is a manifest/name tag, not a runtime mechanic. Source notes follow:
Part3 native repair of source ID 32. Thân và đầu là vòng, 8 lông đuôi là thanh toả ra mang 'mắt lông' là vòng ở đầu, chân và mặt đất là thanh. R3 enlarged from 0.75 to .85 units to make the small eye/flame legible with native authoring geometry. Removed unproven picture-only Bomb and drawing arms; no Booster/Chain. Native .5-unit tube, pins and complete Guides only. Drawing tabs replaced by real engaged joints. Feather S4 uses its own aligned local frame: same world geometry, stable offset direction after canonical numeric serialization; avoids the exact diagonal x/y dominance tie. No engine/tolerance edits. Feather eyes pair along fan arc at native spacing. Body/head spacing fixed; stepped neck has two parallel native pin passages, no redundant Guide. Head rotation releases body after neck withdrawal. Figure silhouette is a design reference, not evidence of difficulty or necessary cross-object preparation for every bar. No campaign import. Validation/full-gesture evidence: research/20261015-genai-part3-v04.
